metadata.title: Crash with SIGFPE due to unhandled cases in distributions.MultivariateNormal

bug_description: torch.distributions.MultivariateNormal crashes when provided with a scalar tensor input, although scalar tensors are valid tensor objects in PyTorch.

trigger_conditions.operation_context: Creating a MultivariateNormal distribution with a scalar location tensor.

failure_behavior.description: The API triggers a SIGFPE crash instead of raising a valid input error.

root_cause_information.description: The bug is related to insufficient validation of scalar tensor inputs.
